create_class_fuyu_for_causal_lm: create a FuyuForCausalLM multimodal model with vision embed tokens and a Persimmon language model for causal language generation
process_images_fuyu_processor: process images into flattened patches and patches-per-image metadata for the Fuyu multimodal model
embed_multimodal_fuyu: embed multimodal image patches through a ColumnParallelLinear layer into hidden state embeddings
compute_logits_fuyu_model: compute logits from hidden states using the PersimmonForCausalLM language model head
load_weights_fuyu: load and map pretrained weights into the Fuyu model using AutoWeightsLoader with HF-to-vLLM weight remapping
